chapter: New Orleans and the tent shows
title: Armstrong waiting for them in St. Louis
summary: Mary recalls arriving by boat in St. Louis to find Armstrong, who worked the river boat, sitting on the theater steps waiting to see Mac and Mac.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And when we come to St. Louis here, here, I mean to St. Louis. I know, yes. Louis come up on a boat with the red, what's his name, red, that used to work on the boat? Oh yeah.
Oh, uh, uh, uh, fake marabout, maybe.
Yes, fake marabout. Yes, well we call him red marbles. Yes, fake marbles. Yes, fake marbles.

And when we come from the, was going to the theater, to rehearsal, there was Louis sitting on steps waiting. Oh right. We got off the boat sitting waiting for us and he played with us a while there and said, Louis. Yes. Uh huh, but he had to go back on the boat. Yes. But he waited there and waiting to see Mac and Mac. You know, there's so much to think about after you think back, but my goodness, there's things to be forgotten.

Well, we had no reason to mention them. Nobody talked to us about them. All those old times, they're all gone. So many of them. Yeah. And so, during this organizing, way back in, if we're talking too long, then let me know.
No, no, no. I don't want to take your whole afternoon, but if you have a few more minutes, I'd like to hear some more about the travels and all.
